prompts.luna_izq: Moonlit night scene. Everything is bathed in cold blue moonlight coming from the right: silver-blue rim light on the ridges, deep navy-blue shadows in every gully, strong blue color grading, local colors desaturated by the moonlight, very dark sky with a few stars. The landscape covers the whole mountain from base to summit. Treat the mountain as one continuous surface texture: vegetation only as low ground cover or as a continuous canopy seen from above, no isolated tall trees, no tall cacti, no poles, no vertical objects, no buildings. The beauty comes from color, rock texture, strata and the raking light that sculpts every ridge and gully. A giant red punzo woolen poncho fabric draped over the whole mountain, following every ridge and gully, heavy woven texture, black guarda pattern at the hem. Natural landscape photography, highly detailed, realistic textures, no people, no text, no buildings unless described.

propuestas.titulo: Propuesta 2026 · poncho del lugar de origen en montañas y laterales
propuestas.nota: Versiones en baja del 16/10 (ComfyUI, Flux Krea). En las montañas va solo la textura sobre el relieve real de cada cerro, recortada con la máscara de mapping; en el LED centro, las laterales con el principal 2025 como referencia. Poncho salteño (de Güemes): bordó con franjas negras anchas.
